117:   ;; Is this guest path one of the statically dispatched DirectX components?
118:   ;; Only the DirectX range answers with the DirectX version; later static
119:   ;; modules such as Glide have distinct handles but are not DirectX DLLs.
120:   (func $name_is_static_dx_dll (param $name i32) (result i32)
121:     (local $idx i32)
122:     (if (i32.eqz (local.get $name)) (then (return (i32.const 0))))
123:     (local.set $idx (call $guest_name_is_static_system_dll (local.get $name)))
124:     (if (i32.eqz (local.get $idx)) (then (return (i32.const 0))))
125:     (i32.and
126:       (i32.ge_u (i32.sub (local.get $idx) (i32.const 1))
127:         (global.get $STATIC_SYS_DLL_FIRST_DX))
128:       (i32.lt_u (i32.sub (local.get $idx) (i32.const 1))
129:         (i32.add (global.get $STATIC_SYS_DLL_FIRST_DX)
130:           (global.get $STATIC_SYS_DLL_DX_COUNT)))))

132:   ;; A native image base back to its 1-based list position, or 0. The image
133:   ;; table is process-shared and entries publish only after header creation.
134:   (func $static_sys_dll_from_handle (param $h i32) (result i32)
135:     (local $idx i32)
136:     (if (i32.eqz (local.get $h)) (then (return (i32.const 0))))
137:     (loop $scan
138:       (if (i32.eq (local.get $h) (i32.atomic.load
139:           (i32.add (global.get $STATIC_SYS_DLL_IMAGES) (i32.shl (local.get $idx) (i32.const 2)))))
140:         (then (return (i32.add (local.get $idx) (i32.const 1)))))
141:       (local.set $idx (i32.add (local.get $idx) (i32.const 1)))
142:       (br_if $scan (i32.lt_u (local.get $idx) (i32.const 64))))
143:     (i32.const 0))

145:   ;; Copy a NUL-terminated linear-memory string into a guest buffer at
146:   ;; character offset $at, stopping at $limit characters. Returns the cursor.
147:   (func $emit_path_part (param $buf_g i32) (param $at i32) (param $limit i32)
148:                         (param $src i32) (param $wide i32) (result i32)
149:     (local $ch i32) (local $step i32)
150:     (local.set $step (select (i32.const 2) (i32.const 1) (local.get $wide)))
151:     (block $done (loop $l
152:       (local.set $ch (i32.load8_u (local.get $src)))
153:       (br_if $done (i32.eqz (local.get $ch)))
154:       (br_if $done (i32.ge_u (local.get $at) (local.get $limit)))
155:       (call $store_char
156:         (i32.add (local.get $buf_g) (i32.mul (local.get $at) (local.get $step)))
157:         (local.get $ch) (local.get $wide))
158:       (local.set $at (i32.add (local.get $at) (i32.const 1)))
159:       (local.set $src (i32.add (local.get $src) (i32.const 1)))
160:       (br $l)))
161:     (local.get $at))

172:       (then (local.set $limit (i32.sub (local.get $size) (i32.const 1)))))

972:   ;; GetFileVersionInfoSizeA(lptstrFilename, lpdwHandle) → size or 0
973:   ;; Reads RT_VERSION (16) from the PE named by lptstrFilename.
974:   (func $handle_GetFileVersionInfoSizeA (param $arg0 i32) (param $arg1 i32) (param $arg2 i32) (param $arg3 i32) (param $arg4 i32) (param $name_ptr i32)
975:     (local $entry i32) (local $size i32)
976:     ;; If lpdwHandle is non-null, set *lpdwHandle = 0
977:     (if (local.get $arg1)
978:       (then (call $gs32 (local.get $arg1) (i32.const 0))))
979:     ;; A DirectX component we dispatch statically has no file on disk, so the
980:     ;; EXE's own resource would be answered instead — which is how an app's
981:     ;; "do you have DirectX 6.1a?" probe ends up reading its own version.
982:     (if (call $name_is_static_dx_dll (local.get $arg0))
983:       (then
984:         (i32.store offset=0 (global.get $reg_base) (global.get $DX_VERSION_INFO_SIZE))
985:         (i32.store offset=16 (global.get $reg_base) (i32.add (i32.load offset=16 (global.get $reg_base)) (i32.const 12)))
986:         (return)))
987:     ;; Ordinary calls inspect the named file, including freshly extracted DLLs.
988:     (call $file_version_info_size_named
989:       (local.get $arg0) (local.get $arg1) (i32.const 0) (i32.const 1))
990:     (drop (local.get $entry))
991:     (drop (local.get $size))

1000:   (func $handle_GetFileVersionInfoA (param $arg0 i32) (param $arg1 i32) (param $arg2 i32) (param $arg3 i32) (param $arg4 i32) (param $name_ptr i32)
1001:     (local $entry i32) (local $rva i32) (local $size i32) (local $len i32)
1002:     (if (call $name_is_static_dx_dll (local.get $arg0))
1003:       (then
1004:         (local.set $len (local.get $arg2))
1005:         (if (i32.gt_u (local.get $len) (global.get $DX_VERSION_INFO_SIZE))
1006:           (then (local.set $len (global.get $DX_VERSION_INFO_SIZE))))
1007:         (memory.copy (call $g2w (local.get $arg3))
1008:           (global.get $DX_VERSION_INFO) (local.get $len))
1009:         (i32.store offset=0 (global.get $reg_base) (i32.const 1))
1010:         (i32.store offset=16 (global.get $reg_base) (i32.add (i32.load offset=16 (global.get $reg_base)) (i32.const 20)))
1011:         (return)))
1012:     ;; The file reader maps RVA through section headers rather than assuming
1013:     ;; the on-disk image has already been loaded at image_base.
1014:     (call $file_version_info_named
1015:       (local.get $arg0) (local.get $arg2) (local.get $arg3) (i32.const 0))
1016:     (drop (local.get $entry))
1017:     (drop (local.get $rva))
1018:     (drop (local.get $size))
1019:     (drop (local.get $len))
